title: John Sebastian Tan
text:
I’m a senior majoring in Statistics & Data Science and Economics at UCLA. I’m passionate about solving problems using data-driven insights and incentives to motivate change. I thrive in collaborative environments and enjoy solving problems with innovative yet simple solutions. I’m currently interested in product or project management roles, where I can empower diverse teams to build outcomes greater than the sum of their parts.
Outside of work, I love engaging with all forms of creative media 📸. In my free time you will find me watching a movie, reading a book, diving into a great game, editing a video, drawing or learning a new software. I also enjoy quality time with my family, playing golf, and running. I’m currently training for a marathon!
I’m a proud Singaporean 🇸🇬, and deeply grateful for the opportunities my family has given me. Their support has shaped my values and continues to motivate everything I pursue.
Welcome to my website, feel free to reach out!


University of California, Los Angeles – Los Angeles, CA
B.S. Statistics & Data Science, B.A. Economics
Expected June 2026 - Summa Cum Laude
Clubs: USAC Community Service Commission, ACM Studio, Film Production Society



Summer Intern, K2 Carbon – Singapore
April 2026 – Present

Engineered an end-to-end data pipeline using Python and PostgreSQL to ingest and standardize public carbon registry data, transforming inconsistently formatted records into a structured database.
Built a Metabase dashboard translating raw carbon registry data into interactive visualizations, enabling non-technical users to conduct exploratory analysis and identify market insights independently.
Supported go-to-market strategy research across emerging voluntary carbon markets, tracking global standards and methodologies including standards such as Verra, Gold Standard, and Plan Vivo.

Project Liaison Advisor, USAC Community Service Commission – Los Angeles, CA
June 2025 – Present

Designed and implemented analytics dashboards in Google Data Studio to monitor funding utilization and project outcomes, identifying underused assets and reallocating resources to maximize program impact.
Analyzed and optimized resource allocation processes for 30+ student-led service organizations, ensuring equitable distribution of $300K+ USD in annual funding and logistics support.
Streamlined communication and onboarding workflows by developing an online bulletin board, tutorial videos, and structured training materials, standardizing operations and reducing coordination time across all project teams.

Financial Controller Intern, SIEMENS Advanta – Prague, Czech Republic
June 2024 – August 2024

Conducted five project-controlling case studies on topics such as purchase volume, IT cost analysis, and manpower planning, utilizing Excel and exploring AI tools to optimize processes.
Shadowed key financial controlling processes, including ordering, time booking, reporting, and cost and supplier analysis, gaining familiarity with SAP invoicing and corporate procedures.

Special Projects Assistant, UCLA Student Development & Health – Los Angeles, CA
March 2024 – June 2025

Partnered with the ResLife Recruitment and Selection Team to assess and improve hiring workflows, structuring processes and documentation that streamlined the selection of 1,000+ applicants from initial screening to final hires.
Implemented SmartSuite project management tools to standardize data collection and record-keeping, enhancing operational visibility, process efficiency, and data accessibility across recruitment cycles.

Resident Assistant, UCLA Residential Life – Los Angeles, CA
September 2023 – June 2024

Selected out of over 2,000 UCLA applicants to be a Resident Assistant (RA), overseeing the wellbeing and safety of 73 student residents in UCLA housing and fostering community by organizing a wide variety of programs.
Completed a comprehensive 2-week training program to refine managerial skills and interpersonal counseling techniques for effective conflict resolution and leadership.

Naval Officer, Platoon Commander, Singapore Armed Forces – Singapore
January 2020 – November 2021

Spearheaded the coordination of daily operations and personnel within the Fast Craft Company in as Officer-Of-The-Day in the Fast Craft Training Unit (FCTU).
Guided and mentored groups of 10 to 20 new recruits at a time; facilitated their training schedules to ensure a safe and effective progression towards operational readiness.
